lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast white vertical line segments traversing the torso; spacing is generally uniform across the mid-section (approx. 40-60 pixels) and narrows slightly toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the upper mid-flank where the 5th and 6th lines from the anterior merge before reaching the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 11th and 12th line segments on the posterior flank are abbreviated, appearing as dashed segments that terminate mid-torso before reaching the ventral mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 5 high-contrast circular spots located on the lateral posterior haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the upper thigh align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white chevron marking on the nasal bridge; two white spots located on the lower cheek; distinct white transverse bands visible on the lower forelimbs and hindlimbs.
